title: Drill drawer "Open in list" opens a wider list than the drawer when the drill filter has two conditions on one field or an `$in`
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWn6zhNa4LL7VB1rtL

Filing gate: ③ an out-of-scope finding handed back by the #30615 card thread with draft PR #30651 (head `f9543126`). It is outside that PR's files. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.

## What happens

The dashboard and report drill drawers offer "Open in list →" (and `drillDown.target: 'navigate'`). Both go through `useOpenRecordList` → `recordListPath`, which writes the drill filter with `serializeDrillFilterParams` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/drillUrlFilters.ts:361`). That encoder is lossy in the widening direction, and its own docblock says so (`:355-359`):

- two conditions on the same field and operator share one param key, so `params.set` keeps the later one (`collectFilterParams`, `:436`);
- an array comparand (`$in` / `$nin`) is skipped (`:433-435`).

The drawer itself reads the full filter, so the drawer and the list it opens disagree. The list is wider than the number the user clicked.

## Repro (app-showcase, PR #30651 head `f9543126`, from the card thread's report)

Revenue Pulse → "Paid Rate by Status" → the "Sent" bar's Paid Invoices (0). With PR #30651 the drawer lists 0 rows (bucket `status = sent` AND the measure scope `status = paid`). "Open in list" writes `filter[status]=sent` only and lists 4 invoices.

The same path serves #30080's KPI tile drawer (PR #30634), whose filter also composes a measure scope with the widget filter.

## Wanted

- [ ] "Open in list" (and the navigate target) offers a destination only when the route can say the drill filter EXACTLY, else no destination. The rule already exists for a related list's "View all": `exactRecordListFilter` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/useOpenRecordList.ts:79`, objectstack#25888) answers `null` for a second comparand on one param, `$in`, `$or` and the rest. The drill escape hatch does not use it today.
- [ ] A test on the repro shape: bucket `{ status: 'sent' }` AND scope `{ status: 'paid' }` offers no "Open in list"; an `$in` scope offers none; a plain equality bucket still offers the same URL as today.

Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/useOpenRecordList.ts`, `drillUrlFilters.ts`, the drawers' `OpenInListButton`).
Dedupe: `serializeDrillFilterParams`, `"Open in list" drill` (is:issue is:open) → only #30615 itself.
